raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Restore Muse Spark NVFP4 + DFlash2 B300 PD coverage in a small follow-up to #44666. The merged PR temporarily disabled this file after [job 117611788593](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39099912264/job/117611788593) failed during server startup: the log shows whole-model Hugging Face cache cleanup immediately before tokenizer loading failed, consistent with a concurrent cache cleanup race.

This PR is now based directly on `main` after #44666 merged, and changes only the test's CI registration. The cache cleanup race still needs validation or a fix before merging this re-enable.

## Modifications

Remove the temporary `disabled` registration from `test_muse_spark_12_b300_pd.py`, restoring its `base-c` / `8-gpu-b300` scheduling. The file is byte-for-byte identical to the version before the temporary skip; all test cases and server settings are preserved.

## Accuracy Tests

- CI registry parsing confirms that this PR enables the test and the merged baseline skips it.
- After rebasing onto `main`, Python syntax validation, pre-commit and `git diff --check` pass; stable patch ID and range diff confirm that the one-file patch is unchanged.
- Full 8x B300 accuracy/performance results remain pending CI; the prior startup failure ran zero tests.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The speculative decoding speed gate remains **500 token/s** and both acceptance-length gates remain **4.7**. This PR changes scheduling only.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #39109930510](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39109930510)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:x: [Run #39109930597](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39109930597)<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->

I opened #45005 to address the shared HF-cache race observed while investigating this re-enable PR.

The CPU regression covers the complete local control flow: the initial validation preserves the shared snapshot, the existing retry path acquires the cache lock and re-checks it, only the incomplete blob is removed while the lock is held, and the mocked download/validation completes. The download itself is mocked, so this is not evidence of a real Hugging Face download recovery or of the original Muse failure's sole cause.

#45005's lint has passed, but its registered `base-a-test-cpu` job was skipped because the PR does not yet have the `run-ci` label. Could you review the fix and enable the CPU CI when appropriate?

files.patch:
@@ -24,12 +24,7 @@
 
 # ci-cost-override: the 816B checkpoint needs two TP4 replicas; one full GSM8K
 # pass covers both NVLink PD transfer and the DFlash2 acceptance regression gate.
-register_cuda_ci(
-    est_time=900,
-    stage="base-c",
-    runner_config="8-gpu-b300",
-    disabled="HF cache cleanup race (#44666); until 2026-11-01",
-)
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=900, stage="base-c", runner_config="8-gpu-b300")
 
 MODEL_PATH = "meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4"
 DRAFT_MODEL_PATH = "RadixArk/Muse-Spark-Open-DFlash2"
